name: Data Hoarders
label: Quest
description: Jemma Quikswitch needs her lost punch cards found in the snow outside Gnomeregan. The exiled gnome in Ironforge copied her family's archives onto cards…
intro: Jemma Quikswitch needs her lost punch cards found in the snow outside Gnomeregan. The exiled gnome in Ironforge copied her family's archives onto cards during the flight from the city. Now several are missing, along with records of submarine designs and family recipes.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Before we fled Gnomeregan, I made a hard copy of my family's archives. Arcanotechnical field equations, Second War submarine hull designs, Grandma Quikswitch's chili recipe... Our greatest accomplishments are in those files.
It wasn't until we reached Ironforge that I found a hole in my pack! Several punch cards are gone, and without them the data's too scrambled to recover.
The cards must be buried in the snow, somewhere outside Gnomeregan. Could you find them? I know it's a long shot...

clips.title: Progress
paras: How is the data retrieval progressing?

clips.title: Completion
paras: These cards seem a bit damp... But I can work with this! Thank you, friend!
